##### Project General Facts

The Atria is a masterpiece of contemporary design, where the luxury of living is redefined by its unique blend of convenience and elegance. This exquisite address boasts a hotel apartment tower and a thirty-storey residential tower, connected by a lavish podium that features opulent three-bedroom duplex apartments, a vibrant retail arena, and a stunning central park-plaza atrium. The Atria's distinctive step-terace structure creates a truly memorable form, with an aesthetic façade that sets it apart from other residential developments.

The Atria's amenities are designed to provide a holistic living experience, with a focus on simplicity, functionality, and urban elegance, complemented by the latest smart home technology. The apartments, designed by the renowned yoo Studio, founded by John Hitchcox and Philippe Starck, exude a characteristic personality and flair, showcasing the yoo Studio Culture Style, an eclectic yet refined palette that blends the beauty of the past with the innovative designs of today. This intriguing mix creates a captivating tension, rooted in richness and boldness, with a powerful sense of history and a forward-looking perspective.

The interior finishing of The Atria is a testament to its commitment to luxury, with calacatta porcelain marble effect tiles, champagne-coloured mirrors, and white lacquer paint, creating a sophisticated and elegant atmosphere. The kitchens are fully equipped, with black silestone work surfaces, while the apartments are fully furnished with black American walnut furniture and doors, adding a touch of warmth and sophistication to the living spaces. The attention to detail in the finishing and materials is a hallmark of The Atria's dedication to providing a truly exceptional living experience.


##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay is a vibrant and stylish community, known for its trendy atmosphere and cutting-edge gadgets. Located on the south side of Downtown Dubai, this area is a hub of activity, with numerous events and festivals taking place throughout the year, including music festivals, Mother's Day celebrations, and New Year's celebrations. The lifestyle in Business Bay offers a unique blend of excitement and convenience, with famous international schools, medical facilities, supermarkets, banks, and finance centres just a short distance away.

The proximity of these amenities makes Business Bay an ideal location for those seeking a high standard of living, with easy access to a wide range of services and facilities. The area is also known for its stunning residential properties, hotel towers, and amazing restaurants, creating a dynamic and cosmopolitan atmosphere. With its face-paced lifestyle and numerous opportunities for entertainment and leisure, Business Bay is the perfect destination for those seeking a life of excitement and adventure.

Business Bay's unique blend of style, convenience, and entertainment makes it an attractive destination for those seeking a high-quality lifestyle. The area's numerous amenities and services, combined with its vibrant atmosphere, create a truly exceptional living experience. With its stunning properties, world-class facilities, and exciting events, Business Bay is a place where residents can elevate their standard of living and enjoy a life of pleasure, success, and fun.
